dialogues.speaker: Mamontov
dialogues.text: A reader of "Pioneers," naturally... Ah. Except the paper has never once printed my picture, has it? Right... My mistake. I appear to have promoted myself a little too soon.

dialogues.speaker: Mamontov
dialogues.text: Truth be told, I write a little column for "Pioneers." My editor says it's been rather popular with readers lately, and, well, I got carried away and thought fame had finally found me.

dialogues.speaker: Mamontov
dialogues.text: You know, I don't really get it. My serious train features, the ones I research and fact-check properly, keep getting rejected. Meanwhile, the half-true little train anecdotes I write off the cuff turn out to be the hit.
